items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: The interviewee mentions Louie Armstrong only in the context of his marriage to Lil Hardin and as a trumpeter he considers the best, but does not describe a direct professional or personal interaction with Armstrong himself.

ctx.x: Did you ever work at Royal Garden?
No. I used to sit in. The girl that Louie married, white fat.
